usageNotes: Use this endpoint to retrieve the full configuration of a specific ACME challenge plugin registered in Proxmox Datacenter Manager, including its DNS API name, credentials data, enabled/disabled state, and validation delay. Requires the System.Modify privilege on the system/certificates path. Call list_config_acme_plugins first to enumerate valid plugin IDs if the ID is not already known.

examples.summary: Fetch details for a DNS-01 ACME plugin named 'cloudflare-dns'

tips: The 'data' field contains raw credential key-value pairs (e.g. CF_Token=xxx); treat it as sensitive — avoid logging the full response.
A plugin returned with 'disable: true' is registered but will not be used for certificate issuance until re-enabled.
The 'validation-delay' field is useful for DNS providers with slow propagation; a value of 120–300 seconds is common for high-TTL zones.
Plugin IDs must match the pattern /^(?:[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9._-]*)$/ and are limited to 32 characters.
